startup:
🟢📡 SNMP watch is LIVE for {name} ({host}).
👀 Tracking: reachability, CPU, memory, disk, uptime{extras}.
🫡 Standing by.
recovered:
✅🎉 SNMP link to {name} ({host}) is back.
📶 Gear answered again. Nice.
reboot:
🔄💥 {name} ({host}): uptime went backwards.
♻️ Looks like a reboot (or a very creative clock).
cmd_help:
🎫 You're on the roster.

Quick buttons below, or commands:
📊 /status — short OK/problems list
🔎 /status_<id> — full details for one device
🚨 /alerts — active alerts
📋 /devices — device list
❓ /help — this text
cmd_denied: 🚫 Nope. Your Telegram id/username is not on the whitelist for this bot.
cmd_unknown_device: 🤷 No device with id `{id}` on this bot. Try /devices.
cmd_no_devices: 📭 This bot is not wired to any device you can access.
